//: The canonical npm scripts. package.json has no include mechanism — npm
cannot extend or merge a manifest the way biome.json and tsconfig.json can
— so this cannot be copied in. tsq/sync-config prints it and you paste it.
This is the ts-quality analog of rust-quality's cargo aliases: anything
that is ONE invocation lives here, not in a provision component, so it
works in a terminal, in CI and in an editor with no provision installed.
Components exist only for multi-step gates and for config sync.
